svg.text: Plan, north up, 1 px = 1.52 m. Estate frame: x east, y north, z = estate lawn (0). Terrain = blender/wilderness/terrain.py (+ proposed knicks hook) test run at 1.5 m (terrain local = estate + (0, 810)).
Colours = vegetation communities placed by the masks (rules in brief.md). Contours every 20 m, bold every 100 m. Mid-June, golden hour.
hay meadow (cleared bench), 110-130 m to the forest edge
Laurel Fork Falls (16 m drop, lip -116)
hay meadow: the estate's cleared bench
cove forest: tulip poplar, buckeye, sugar maple, hemlock
oak-hickory: red oak, hickory, white pine
ridge: chestnut oak, pine, mountain laurel
1.92 km: up 243 m, crest walk west
0.81 km off-trail, ends at Painted Rock
checked view back to the house (upper floor)
Heights (z vs lawn; asl if gate = 1,040 m)
N: the hedge and the meadow (the estate)
W: the Narrows, a boulder-choked chute
E: Raven Spur falls to the estate road
S: the parkway below the crest
everywhere: laurel hells and slopes > 40 deg
playable ~1.3 x 1.25 km; backdrop to 4.6 km
Section along the view line: house - meadow - Poplar Cove - Laurel Fork - Painted Rock - crest (true scale)
Green = canopy model used for the sight checks (35 m cove trees, 25 m upper slopes, 15 m dry crests, 4-8 m laurel slick / talus). Blue dashed: Painted Rock sees the upper floor over the treetops.
